sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct is Meta's largest instruction-tuned language model in the Llama 3.1 family, built by meta-llama. This 405-billion parameter model uses an optimized transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for improved inference scalability. sources.snippet: The Llama 3.1 405B-Instruct NIM simplifies the deployment of the Llama 3.1 405B instruction tuned model which is optimized for language understanding, reasoning, and text generation use cases, and outperforms many of the available open source chat models on common industry benchmarks.
